violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as raw chicken and raw ground beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as eggrolls, noodles, produce) in the walk-in and 2 door refrigerators. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener and knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Fried rice, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC disposed of rice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Noodles and garlic were observed held between 50-65 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of noodles and placed garlic in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed fried rice still cooling in the walk-in cooler in a container greater than four inches deep from the night before. PIC disposed of fried rice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Inspector observed raw frozen meat in freezer chest, which was unprotected. PIC informed to wrap or place frozen chicken in a food grade plastic bag or container. Containers of food items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
Inspector observed several frozen items stored in non-food safe plastic shopping bags in deep chest freezers. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigerator/prep unit/chest freezer equipment have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
Inspector observed food items stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer units. PIC informed to use food grade bags. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
Various food items in buckets were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026

Inspector observed raw frozen chicken in freezer chest, which was unprotected. PIC informed to wrap or place frozen chicken in a food grade plastic bag or container. New Violation. Correct By: 04/27/2026
